description: This file contains functions for initializing and managing default templates in the Focalboard application, including template import logic, version checks, and board/block fixing functions.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for template management.

methods.name: initializeTemplates
methods.description: Imports default templates if the boards table is empty or contains outdated templates.

methods.name: isInitializationNeeded
methods.description: Checks if template initialization is needed based on existing boards and their versions.

methods.name: fixTemplateBlock
methods.description: Adjusts blocks to be inserted as part of a template, skipping certain blocks based on cache.

methods.name: fixTemplateBoard
methods.description: Adjusts boards to be inserted as templates, removing '(NEW)' from titles and setting template properties.
